changelog.change: LTHR updated 173 -> 176 from 30-min field test (Garmin auto-detect). Converted lthr from a scalar to a date-versioned history so historical runs are graded against the zones that were actually in effect. Retired sub-3:35 stretch goal. Revised Phase 2 tempo prescriptions.

goal.label: sub-3:50
goal.confidence: reachable — requires ~5-10 min of fitness gain across Phase 2 + Phase 3

retired_goals.label: sub-3:35
retired_goals.reason: LTHR field test put current marathon-equivalent at 3:55-4:05. Not achievable this cycle.

lthr_history.note: TODO: effective_from is a placeholder. Replace with the real date the 173 rebase happened if it can be recovered.

lthr_history.source: 30-min field test, Garmin Forerunner 265 auto-detected threshold
lthr_history.caveat: Test run in evening heat, not morning. Evening conditions elevate HR at a given effort, so 176 may sit 1-2 bpm high. Zones stand, but schedule the September retest for a morning slot so the two tests are comparable.

current.basis: final 20 min of 30-min field test — 3.83 km in 20:01
current.note: Garmin's own reported threshold pace was not captured. If available in Connect, add it as garmin_reported for cross-check.

heat_model.note: Applies above the feels-like threshold. Use to flag runs where raw pace/HR should not be compared to cooler sessions.
heat_model.treadmill_conversion: Treadmill ~15-20 s/km and ~5-8 bpm easier than outdoor Singapore; compare outdoor-to-outdoor only
heat_model.cool_windows: Start before 6:30am or after 6:30pm; heat reliably arrives 7:15-7:30am

fueling.training_rule: Full gel plan practised on every run >= 16km

checkpoints.name: Marathon-pace HR gate
checkpoints.test: Run a sustained marathon-pace segment at 5:27/km inside a long run, read avg HR

thresholds.amber: 163-167 bpm — borderline, hold goal but watch

known_issues: HR has not dropped as expected across the build — Efficiency Factor trend is the priority diagnostic.
Avg cadence 163 spm at threshold pace is low; stride length 1.12 m is doing the work. Worth a cadence drill block.
Strength training planned but not started as of 2026-07-30.
Garmin sweat_loss_ml is a flat 1000 ml/hr constant, not a measurement. True rate in Singapore heat is likely 1.5-2 L/hr. Not stored or charted; do not treat device figures as measured.
Three runs previously assumed to be morning sessions were evening (31 Jul 17:12, 1 Aug 18:00, 30 Jul 18:14). Pace/HR comparisons across runs need the time_of_day filter.

conventions.long_run_grading: Controlled progression - Z2 to Z3 drift acceptable late in run; easy runs held to strict Z2
conventions.water_stops: Walk through, never pause the timer (keeps HR data honest)
conventions.zone_changes: Only via field test, never watch auto-detection

fuelling_programme.ladder: 3 gels next long run, then 4, 5, 6 — reaching 60 g/hr at the October 30 km runs
